subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is proverbial.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Proverbial: **well known and talked about by a lot of people. लोकप्रसिद्घ, जाना-माना
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4 is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mythical: **existing only in myths. जो केवल मिथकों में हो, मिथकीय
 
• **Hypothetical: **based on situations that have not yet happened, not on facts. प्राक्‍कल्‍पना पर आधारित
 
• **Classified: **officially secret. अधिकृत रूप से गोपनीय
